name: What are the benefits of adding a guest home to my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding a guest home to my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a guest home offers numerous benefits, including increased property value, potential rental income, and flexible living space. It can serve as a home for aging family members, a dedicated home office, a private space for adult children, or a revenue-generating rental unit. Guest homes provide privacy and independence while keeping loved ones or tenants close. They also offer a more affordable housing solution compared to buying a separate property, maximizing the use of existing land.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits of adding a guest home include increased property value, rental income potential, and flexible space for family, guests, or a home office.
